indoor electrical supply/voltage: not published for indoor unit (supply shown at outdoor unit)
indoor fan motor output / fan electrical input: not published
capacityClass: no published kW class scalar; '42' is a model size code
SEER 7,5 / SCOP 4,6 / Pdesign / EER / COP / annual kWh / energy-label A++ are system (42AW/S/B + 42A) ratings, not indoor-unit facts

sound pressure row 'Silence/Bas/Haut' publishes 4 slash values (45/37/29/21*) under 3 labels; exact cell-to-label mapping ambiguous; values recorded in published order; asterisk = +2 dBA in Multi configuration
colour suffix AW/AS/AB are distinct references (white/silver/black); grouped as one 42AW/S/B column, not split into separate files this batch
page footnote: blue cells = preliminary data; airflow/filter/electrical-input/heating-sound-power cells are blue -> treated as unpublished/unknown
